units.source_text: 且说六条院的明石小女公子，定于四月二十过后入宫。

en.t: Now the young Lady Akashi of Rokujo-in was appointed to enter the palace after the twentieth day of the fourth month.

units.source_text: 四月中旬正值贺茂祭佳节，紫夫人欲于前一日先去参拜贺茂神社，照例邀请诸夫人同行。

en.t: In mid-April, during the splendid Kamo Festival season, Lady Murasaki wished to visit the Kamo Shrine on the preceding day and, as usual, invited the other ladies to accompany her.

units.source_text: 诸夫人认为跟她同行，形似随从，不甚体面，所以大家不去。

en.t: The ladies felt that going with her would make them look like attendants and would not be very dignified, so none of them went.

units.source_text: 于是源氏太政大臣偕同紫夫人和女公子三人前往，排场并不铺张，只用车子二十辆，前驱人数亦不甚多。

en.t: Thus Genji, the Grand Minister, went with Lady Murasaki and the young lady, the three of them together; the display was not extravagant, with only twenty carriages and not many outriders.

units.source_text: 一切从简，倒也别有风趣。

en.t: Everything was kept simple, which gave the outing a charm of its own.
At daybreak on the festival day, they entered the temple and paid their respects.

units.source_text: 归时共上看台，观赏美景。

en.t: On the way back, they all went up to the viewing stand to enjoy the beautiful scene.

units.source_text: 众侍女的车子连成一串，停在看台前面，阵容甚是美观。

en.t: The carriages of the many gentlewomen formed a long line and stood before the viewing stand, making a very handsome procession.

units.source_text: 远处望来，都认识这是太政大臣家的行列，气势好盛大！

en.t: Even from a distance, everyone could tell that this was the procession of the Grand Minister's household, and how splendid its presence was.

units.source_text: 源氏想起了秋好皇后的母亲六条妃子的车子被挤退的旧事，对紫夫人言道：“倚仗权势，盛气凌人，而做此种行径，毕竟是罪过的。

en.t: Genji remembered the old incident when the carriage of the Rokujo Consort, mother of Empress Akikonomu, had been pushed aside, and said to Lady Murasaki, "To rely on power, bully others with arrogance, and behave in such a way is, in the end, a sin.

units.source_text: 你看那位傲慢的葵夫人，终于抱恨而死！”

en.t: Just look at that proud Lady Aoi; in the end she died bearing resentment."

units.source_text: 死时怪异情状，避而不谈。

en.t: He avoided speaking of the strange circumstances surrounding her death.

units.source_text: 只说：“再看两人的后代：夕雾只是一个普通平民，好容易逐步升官；而秋好皇后则位极人臣，莫能与并。

en.t: He only said, "Look also at the descendants of the two women: Yugiri began merely as an ordinary subject and rose in office only gradually with great effort, while Empress Akikonomu reached the highest rank a courtier could attain, with no one to equal her.

units.source_text: 思想起来，实在深可感慨！

en.t: When one thinks about it, it truly stirs deep emotion.

units.source_text: 世事无常，夭寿不定，所以人生在世期间，总想随心所欲，任意行事。

en.t: The world is impermanent, and no one knows whether life will be short or long, so while alive people always want to follow their desires and act as they please.

units.source_text: 然而只怕我死之后，剩你一人在世，代我身受报应，弄得晚年孤苦伶仃……”

en.t: Yet I fear that after I die, you will be left alone in the world, suffering the consequences in my place and spending your later years in loneliness and hardship..."

units.source_text: 说到这里，王侯公卿等都上看台来了，源氏大臣便前往就座。

en.t: As he spoke to this point, princes and high courtiers all came up onto the viewing stand, so Minister Genji went over and took his seat.
